title: package.json with a Crust build configuration
description: package.json schema for CLIs built with Crust. Point "$schema" at ./node_modules/@crustjs/crust/schema/package.json to get completion for the "crust" block alongside the standard package.json fields.

crust.description: Build configuration read by `crust build`. `artifact` is required unless every build passes --artifact; the other keys are optional. Unknown keys fail the build. Command names and their source entries come from the standard `bin` field.

runtime.description: Runtime the CLI is built for. Without it: deno.json/deno.jsonc selects deno; @types/node without @types/bun selects node; otherwise bun.

artifact.description: What `crust build` distributes; the --artifact flag overrides it. `package`: a root-only runtime package whose commands are JavaScript bundles run by the consumer's installed runtime (bun, node, or experimental deno, bundled with deno bundle; Deno consumers choose permissions with deno run / deno install). `binary`: standalone executables in per-platform npm packages behind a Node launcher (bun, deno, or node; node binaries are built by tsdown with a node on PATH that meets its executable requirements, Node 26 or later for the bundled tsdown 0.23).

targets.description: Canonical compiler targets `crust build` stages for binaries when no --target flag is passed, or `host` for the building machine (e.g. bun-linux-x64, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, or linux-x64 for node); without it every target of the compiler is staged. Rejected for runtime packages.

bunPlugins.description: Bun bundler plugin modules applied to Bun binaries and runtime packages (bun or node), in order: bare names resolve from node_modules, paths from the project root; each must default-export the plugin. Rejected for Deno and for node binaries.

include.description: Directories relative to the project root that `crust build` copies into .crust/root/ and into each platform package's bin/.

external.description: Packages left out of a node or bun runtime package's bundle and shipped as `dependencies` of the staged root package with their package.json `dependencies` range, e.g. native addons, packages the CLI reads files from or runs, or very large dependencies. Each must be a `dependencies` key with a publishable range (no workspace:, catalog:, file:, link:, or portal:); @crustjs/* packages are rejected. Rejected for binaries and for Deno.
